paper_title: Detecting Ultralight Bosonic Dark Matter via Absorption in Superconductors
notes: Projection paper (Hochberg, Lin, Zurek 2016) proposing aluminum superconductor for ultralight bosonic DM absorption. Presents three coupling projections: hidden photon kinetic mixing (DarkPhoton, Fig 3), pseudoscalar-electron g_aee (AxionElectron, Fig 4), and scalar-electron d_phiee (ScalarElectron, Fig 5). Per hint, AxionElectron selected, but multiple couplings present so confidence is reduced. Data points are rough estimates read from Fig 4 (1 kg-year reach curve, g_aee vs m_a). Local DM density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 stated. 95% CL (3.6 events).
